examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job
at the start of a sentence

examples.trans: The car is driving out of the yard.

meanings.en: to question persistently, pump for info

examples.trans: She kept asking questions about the money.
There is no need to question me.

meanings.note: substantivized adjective from выходной день; declines like an adjective

examples.trans: It's a day off, after all.

examples.text: Что ты делаешь в эти выходные?
examples.trans: What are you doing this weekend?

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.note: belonging to children or from childhood

examples.trans: This is an old children's book.
He's very good with his hands.
I was born and grew up here.
A small key to the cabinet.

meanings.en: что ли — or something, or what?
meanings.note: colloquial tag at the end of a question

examples.text: Вы что, меня покупаете, что ли?
examples.trans: What, are you buying me or something?
I don't know whether he is home.

meanings.note: fleeting vowel о drops in genitive/dative/prepositional (любви), kept in instrumental (любовью)

examples.text: Первый раз я запел про любовь!
examples.trans: For the first time I sang of love!

examples.text: Марина, послушайте, это всё из-за любви!
examples.trans: Marina, listen, it's all because of love!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

плевать.gloss: not to care, couldn't care less (+ dative)

meanings.en: couldn't care less, don't care (colloquial predicative: мне плевать на + accusative)

examples.text: Если тебе плевать на дочь, то мне нет!
examples.trans: If you don't care about our daughter, I do!

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)

meanings.note: понял? = got it?; понял = got it

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: He says nasty things about me.

meanings.en: to check, to test, to verify

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.text: Сейчас через сад и мост — и дома.
examples.trans: Right now through the park and the bridge, and I'm home.
The children are walking in the town park.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.
They put bad meat in there for you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
